general_and_basics.answer: Hello! I am your AI Astrologer. Based on your calculated birth chart with Ascendant in {ascendant}, Sun in {sun_sign}, and Moon in {moon_sign}, I can provide personalized guidance across career, finance, relationships, and health.
Your calculated Lagna (Ascendant) is in {ascendant}. In Vedic astrology, the Lagna represents your physical body, innate personality, and overall life path.
Your calculated Moon Sign (Rashi) is in {moon_sign}. The Moon sign rules your mind, emotional processing, and internal state of peace.
Your calculated Sun Sign is in {sun_sign}. The Sun governs your core identity, soul purpose, leadership ability, and self-confidence.
A birth chart (Kundali) is an astronomical map of the sky at the exact moment and location of your birth. With your Ascendant in {ascendant}, it reveals planetary influences shaping your life events.
A Dasha is a major planetary period in Vimshottari astrology that activates specific houses and planets in your chart over defined years.

career.answer: With your Ascendant in {ascendant} and Sun in {sun_sign}, major career changes align with transits over your 10th house (profession) or 6th house (work environment). Active Sun or Mercury periods bring favorable hiring opportunities.
Promotions occur when your 10th house lord and Sun (governing authority) receive positive aspects, highlighting your professional achievements to management.
Success in government roles requires a strong Sun position. With your Sun placed in {sun_sign}, administrative roles align with favorable 10th house dasha timing.
Business capability is ruled by the 7th house (partnerships/trade) and Mercury. Given your Lagna in {ascendant}, a strong 7th house lord favors self-employment over a traditional job.
Overseas career opportunities are activated when the 9th house (long journeys) and 12th house (foreign lands) connect with your 10th house lord.

professional_life.answer: Your daily work environment is governed by your 6th house. With your Moon in {moon_sign}, maintaining emotional balance during challenging Saturn transits helps reduce stress.
Leadership capacity depends on your Sun in {sun_sign} and 10th house strength. Favorable Sun transits boost your authority and decision-making capabilities.
Workplace friction is linked to 6th house afflictions. Maintaining formal communication during malefic transits protects your professional reputation.
Learning efforts are favored when Mercury (intellect) and your 5th house receive positive aspects from Jupiter, accelerating career progression.

finance.answer: Wealth accumulation is strongest during favorable Jupiter transits over your 2nd house (wealth) and 11th house (gains). Focus on long-term assets when your Lagna ({ascendant}) is well-supported.
Financial growth depends on Dhana Yogas formed between the 2nd and 11th houses. With your Sun in {sun_sign} and Lagna in {ascendant}, sustained efforts during major dasha cycles build lasting wealth.
The 6th house rules debts and liabilities. Favorable Saturn and Mars transits create the stability needed to clear loans systematically.
Sudden wealth is governed by the 8th house and Rahu. Strong, unafflicted aspects on your 8th house lord during Rahu or Venus periods indicate potential windfalls.

financial_status.answer: Your overall financial standing is calculated from the connections between your 2nd house (accumulated wealth) and 11th house (income). With Moon in {moon_sign}, disciplined planning ensures steady growth.
Cash flow flexibility is governed by the 2nd house lord and Mercury. Maintaining liquid reserves cushions against volatile transits.
Borrowing capacity depends on a well-placed 6th house lord. Timely debt repayments protect your financial standing.
Passive income streams activate when your 11th house lord connects with Jupiter and the 9th house of fortune.

personal_life.answer: Marriage timing is influenced by Jupiter transits over your 7th house (partnerships) and active Venus dasha periods. With your Ascendant in {ascendant}, relationship harmony is favored during major Venus aspects.
A direct connection or aspect between the 5th house (romance) and 7th house (marriage) strongly indicates a love marriage.
Your partner's personality is reflected by the sign on your 7th house cusp and the placement of Venus (for men) or Jupiter (for women).
Relationship strain often occurs during Rahu/Ketu transits across the 1st/7th axis. With Moon in {moon_sign}, open communication supports resolution.
Children and progeny are ruled by the 5th house and Jupiter. Favorable transits over your 5th house mark auspicious windows for family expansion.

health.answer: Overall vitality is governed by your Ascendant lord ({ascendant}) and the Sun ({sun_sign}). Strengthening your Lagna lord enhances general immunity and resilience.
Mental well-being is tied to your Moon sign in {moon_sign}. Soft aspects from Jupiter on the Moon help alleviate anxiety and mental fatigue.
Health challenges relate to the 6th house (disease) and 8th house. Positive Saturn transits and disciplined daily routines support recovery.
Digestive health is ruled by the 5th house and the Sun ({sun_sign}). Consuming simple, home-cooked meals during afflicted Sun transits supports digestion.
